selection: All four architectures trained with all three seeds. Select one physics candidate per fold by ensemble seven-horizon validation MAE, including the retained incumbent. Lock all folds before evaluation. Always report every model.
actor: Reuse only verified frozen actors and train-only length calibration from the identical retained split, never across folds.
scope: Retrospective architecture and objective ablation on already reused records. No untouched-test, exact TCN-paper reproduction, or best-in-literature claim.
